$comment: Style pack: Quiet Editorial UI. Ported from github.com/audrey-560/quiet-editorial-ui (MIT) at ff0b65e; see docs/PROVENANCE.md. Changes from the reference: the display face is HyperFrames' bundled EB Garamond instead of licensed Georgia (user decision 2026-10-08), and no italic is bundled, so emphasis is a drawn ink underline, not italic. UI sizes are raised for phone viewing (labels 24 px, UI 30 px, body 34 px at 1080 wide). success-deep is used for text and filled pills (success falls under 3:1 as text). Workflow and judgment: .agents/skills/style-quiet-editorial/SKILL.md.
label: Quiet Editorial UI
use: Calm editorial frames: a large serif line, precise Inter labels, warm near-white surfaces, hairlines, cards, a cursor that selects, one green completed state. Product, SaaS, tutorials, thought leadership.

display.$note: bundled; stands in for Georgia (display weight 400 only)

body.$note: bundled; body and metadata in muted

captions.alt: editorial-clean on the warm canvas or a clean wall
captions.$note: 2-4 words, one line, no punctuation shown, one --emphasis word at most per beat.

sfx.$note: Quiet UI sounds, only for causal events (a select, a confirm). Most beats need none.
